measurements.R_shared: clip(g0(x) + s), s = mean change over all training windows (E18's filed arm)
measurements.R_cue: clip(g0(x) + s_k), s_k = mean change over training windows whose trigger token is x's
measurements.R_near: clip(g0(x) + mean change of the 8 training windows nearest x in g0)
measurements.R_clu_K: clip(g0(x) + mean change of x's k-means cluster of training g0), K in (8, 32, 128), seed 0
measurements.R_rand: as R_clu_32 with random labels, mean of 5 draws (the size-matched null)
measurements.R_fix: clip(a g0(x) + b), a and b per subcomponent by least squares over training windows; a subcomponent whose g0 varies by less than 0.01 (sd) there gets a = 1, b = its mean change (cuefree.line)
measurements.purity_32: share of training windows whose K=32 cluster's most common cue is their own; reported
measurements.R_clu_32_net: E32/E33's net mean form with the K=32 clusters in place of cues: (rho(m1_j) - rho(m0_j)) / rho_trig; expected within 0.1 of R_cue_net where F holds; reported
measurements.R_shared_net / R_cue_net: E32/E33's net mean forms, (rho(m1) - rho(m0)) / rho_trig over all windows or per cue: gates only
measurements.all R: rho / rho_trig, rho = (lo - L00) / gap at the trigger, W0's values elsewhere (commute.regating)
